scenes.text: Imagine you are walking through a remote Mexican desert when suddenly your compass spins completely out of control, your phone loses all signal, and your analog car radio goes dead.
Welcome to the Mapimi Silent Zone, a mysterious magnetic patch of land where radio waves vanish into thin air, which once caused a secret United States military missile to crash here.

Scientists retrieving that crashed wreckage quickly discovered that cosmic space debris and heavy metallic meteorites are magnetically pulled down to this exact zone more than almost anywhere else on our planet.

With terrified locals constantly reporting eerie glowing lights hovering above the giant desert cacti, would you ever dare to camp out in this silent wasteland? Comment your thoughts below and follow for more.
